content.v: 此前，《全面战争：幕府将军2》完全版发售后遭遇了海量的玩家差评。世嘉不得不从数字商店下架，并重新恢复上线2011年的原始版本。 Creative Assembly 对此回应称，该版本完全是外包团队打造，也未接受其内部质量保证检测。
https://image.gcores.com/a4908ca7fbc5cdf0b07346e02994f503-400-400.jpg
Creative Assembly副总裁罗杰·柯勒姆在官方论坛表示，他们与玩家同样愤怒。虽然柯勒姆在文中未直接提及实际负责开发本次完全版的第三方工作室 Mataboo ，但他反复强调 Creative Assembly 未参与项目，以此拉开与这次风波的距离。
针对完全版使用 AI 的质疑，柯勒姆称 Creative Assembly 严格禁止使用生成式 AI ，且这一标准同样适用于所有外部合作开发商。

content.v: 随着日前的 Steam 更新，个人日历功能正式结束 Steam 实验室的实验，成为 Steam 商店的正式功能。玩家可以在自己的 Steam 商店主页找到个人日历，也可以通过这里的链接查看。
https://image.gcores.com/2ccd24ad79fc6cc8f599512be3272829-1408-458.png
V社表示， Steam 个人日历提供了另一种方式来查看算法推荐的游戏。这个功能会将近期发行的游戏和即将推出的游戏进行筛选，然后将V社认为您最有可能感兴趣的一系列游戏呈现在您眼前。 算法会利用玩家近期玩过的游戏来查找与您游戏时间情况相似的玩家，然后查看他们都给自己的愿望单添加了什么游戏，又或者一直在玩什么游戏。
基于您常玩的游戏：系统会重点关注您在玩得最多的游戏上花费的游戏时间。因此，花几分钟时间尝试一两款新游戏并不会过多影响对您进行的推荐，但是花很多时间玩一款新的心头好则会有很大影响。
每日刷新：这个推荐系统每天都会进行重新训练，纳入最新的数据。实际上，您不太可能看到为您进行的推荐每天有很大变化，但随着时间流逝，您可以明显看到，随着 8 周的日历范围不断向前更新，或是随着游戏锁定了其发行日期，新的内容会不断出现。
https://image.gcores.com/9f7e4793ef1064266b87366deb382cfd-1912-1195.png
扩展探索游戏的方式
Steam 商店有多种不同的游戏推荐方式。首页的某些栏目倾向于展示更热门的游戏，而另一些栏目则倾向于展示与您玩的游戏类似的游戏，并不考虑这些游戏已发行多久。 个人日历旨在填补两者之间的空白：在最近推出或即将发行的游戏中，帮助玩家发现他们可能感兴趣的热门和小众之作。
这种做法似乎引起了许多玩家的强烈共鸣，因为V社看到许多人大量探索和点击个人日历中的游戏。
举例而言，以每 24 小时的平均值计，玩家们在 Steam 个人日历中点击了超过 2000 款不同的游戏。这表明，不仅个人日历成功地为玩家匹配到了他们最可能感兴趣的游戏，而且玩家还会深入探索自己的日历，查看有哪些新作问世，又有哪些游戏会在较远的未来推出。
为什么要进 Steam 实验室？
个人日历在 2025 年 10 月首次作为 Steam 实验室的实验推出。 Steam 实验室是V社给新的商店和探索功能所设置的，V社觉得这些功能很有意思，但还需要更有针对性的反馈，才能不断打磨成为完善的产品。经过 11 个月里玩家和开发者不断的反馈，V社终于能够将个人日历打磨成为一个发现新游戏的绝佳方式。
https://image.gcores.com/725b4eeed7430da9da5624382d98fe5a-1280-720.jpg

在这项功能于 Steam 实验室的开发过程中，V社进行了大大小小多项改进。例如，V社为游戏开发者添加了一项功能，可以指定将游戏从抢先体验转为 1.0 版发行的预计日期，这样V社就可以在日历上列出这些游戏。V社也为加入愿望单的游戏、抢先体验游戏及 DLC 等内容添加了更好的筛选工具和显示选项。此外，V社还投入了大量的工作，让这个新功能可以在不同设备——包括台式 PC、移动设备和 Steam 设备——上都顺畅运作。
常见问题
问：这其中有任何游戏是付费而得到显示的吗？
答：没有。V社不会出售 Steam 个人日历上或 Steam 上任意其他地方的广告位。个人日历也并非手动鉴选的。个人日历中的展示是通过算法进行的，会针对每个用户进行个性化调整。
问：我是否会困在推荐的信息茧房中，只看到与我最近在玩的游戏类似的内容？
答：官方也担心困在信息茧房（即获得的推荐范围过窄）中的可能，因此努力保持内容的多样性。在个人日历中，不太可能每天都有与您在玩的游戏类型/主题相同的游戏发行，且该游戏也很适合推荐给您。因此，个人日历生成的推荐最终会从每天发行的各种类型的游戏中产生，范围会更广。

content.v: 《欧洲卡车模拟2》“冰岛”DLC将于11月11日发售。据悉，这项地图扩展将带来一条环冰岛的旅游风景线，连接一系列迷人的城市和偏远的定居点，它们都坐落在一个冰与火交织的世界里。雄伟的山脉、无尽的平原、险峻的悬崖、火山口、咆哮的河流和倾流而下的瀑布，这些都由我们的地图设计师精心重现。
https://image.gcores.com/7a8c19643cce2439bf6fed3954279da6-1920-1080.jpg
https://image.gcores.com/f11221bf2a78e8e45b235ad13c1f4c0d-1920-1080.jpg
开发者表示，这是一项绝无仅有的 DLC，有着丰富的景色与未受污染的自然。冰岛是地球上最非凡的国家之一，拥有独一无二的地貌和无与伦比的自然风光。这个岛国拥有令人惊叹的自然奇观：屹立的火山、庞大的冰川、黑色的沙滩、奔流的瀑布、壮观的火山口等等，使其成为世界各地游客的梦想之地。现在，你将有机会以真正独特的视角，驾驶开车感受这一切。
https://image.gcores.com/62b580731aaf8b9840d8e1884a2e9818-1920-1080.jpg
https://image.gcores.com/8a6f4eb4593835d6d5ddd954f1ea3796-1920-1080.jpg
https://image.gcores.com/bf3742249b2bb34714c2a22fdc360c89-1920-1080.jpg
由于冰岛独特的地理位置，请不要期待看到密集的高速公路网或熙熙攘攘的城市群。取而代之的是，准备好迎接一场感受地球上最震撼的自然风光之一的旅程吧。
https://image.gcores.com/a489d28220a133d75f2d2604db7e5537-1920-1080.jpg
https://image.gcores.com/7905e13d614400de369b3667618f94d1-1920-1080.jpg
每一公里均捕捉冰岛原始、未受破坏的环境的壮丽与真实性。如果你曾想驾车感受大自然的壮丽，那么现在就是完美的机会。你可以期待在环岛公路（Hringvegur）运送货物，这条公路长约1,400公里，环绕整个冰岛。除了其他城市和定居点外，这项地图扩展的亮点之一是首都雷克雅未克，一座充满活力、创意迸发、由惊人自然美景环绕的城市。

content.v: DC宇宙版蝙蝠侠近日再现选角传闻。业内消息人士杰夫·斯奈德称，詹姆斯·古恩筹备中的蝙蝠侠电影可能围绕一位年龄较大的布鲁斯·韦恩展开，格伦·鲍威尔被列为主要热门人选。不过，这项说法目前缺乏充分证据。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261026/1792975593_438858.webp
有关“年长蝙蝠侠”的判断，主要依据古恩在2023年的一则回复。他当时仅表示超人不到40岁，蝙蝠侠“可能”比超人年长几岁，并未确认布鲁斯会被设定为中年人，也没有公布任何候选演员。传闻所指方向或与本·阿弗莱克饰演的版本存在相似之处。
这部电影名为《英勇无畏》，最初公布的构想包括布鲁斯抚养亲生儿子达米安·韦恩，达米安将成为罗宾，与父亲共同打击犯罪。古恩后来被问及计划是否已有变化时只回答“是”，没有说明具体调整了哪些设定。
目前，蝙蝠侠在该DC宇宙中仅以剪影短暂出现，正式演员、角色年龄以及父子故事是否保留均未确定。社交平台上虽然出现了反对格伦·鲍威尔出演的声音，但这些意见不代表制片方态度，也不能视为选角取得进展。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261026/1792975602_332277_jpeg_r.jpeg
外媒详细报道：

随着部分DC宇宙项目的选角传闻不断浮出水面，业内爆料人Jeff Sneider在X上发布的一则《蝙蝠侠》选角消息，在一些网络社群中引发了热议。据悉，在詹姆斯·古恩即将推出的《蝙蝠侠》电影中，粉丝们可能会看到一位年龄较大的蝙蝠侠，类似本·阿弗莱克饰演的版本。斯奈德还表示，演员格伦·鲍威尔是目前最热门的人选。这一说法的依据是什么?似乎是古恩在2023年发布的一条推文，其中提到蝙蝠侠可能比超人年长几岁。
粉丝们似乎并不太期待由格伦·鲍威尔饰演蝙蝠侠，尤其是此前克里斯蒂安·贝尔和罗伯特·帕丁森等演员已经对这个角色作出了极其出色的诠释。至于蝙蝠侠将是一位四十多岁中年人的说法，现有依据充其量也十分薄弱。古恩此前的推文原文是：“我只说过，超人不到四十岁，而蝙蝠侠可能比超人大几岁。”针对斯奈德那条说法相反的推文，一名DC粉丝表示：“詹姆斯自己说过，他们不想找一位中年演员。”

事实上，我们仍然没有更接近这部电影的确切信息，选角方面尤其如此，因为多年来，古恩一直在公开驳斥有关该项目的不实或误导性报道。关于这部名为《英勇与无畏》的电影，目前可以确定的是，自几年前首次公布以来，相关计划已经发生变化。最初的构想是让布鲁斯·韦恩进入为人父的阶段，抚养自己的亲生儿子达米安·韦恩。达米安最终将接过罗宾的衣钵，与父亲并肩打击犯罪。但当有人在Threads上询问古恩，如今的计划是否已经不同于2023年公布时的版本，他迅速而直接地回答：“是的。”
这基本上就是目前外界对这部电影所掌握的全部信息。迄今为止，在DC宇宙的世界观中，蝙蝠侠只以剪影形式短暂现身，稍不留神就会错过。因此，古恩完全可以让这个角色朝任何方向发展，尤其是在他认为自己不必受最初剧本构想约束的情况下。由于当前版本DC宇宙中的超人相对年轻，蝙蝠侠究竟会被设定为多大年纪、他是否仍将在这部即将推出的作品中呈现父亲的一面，以及目前有哪些演员正在候选名单上，确实都无从得知。

content.v: DC宇宙恐怖电影《泥脸》首周末全球票房约4300万美元，低于《超级少女》的6800万美元开画成绩。不过，两部影片的成本差距较大，单凭首周数字难以直接判断其商业表现。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261026/1792974915_118003_jpg_r.jpg
《超级少女》制作成本超过1.7亿美元，最终全球票房为1.265亿美元；《泥脸》的成本约为4400万美元，因此即使开画规模较小，也更容易接近盈利区间。目前，《泥脸》尚不能确定已经盈利，最终结果仍取决于后续跌幅和海外收入。
《泥脸》同时登上当周全球票房榜首，成为派拉蒙与华纳合并后第二部夺得周末冠军的影片，上一部是前一周上映的《街头霸王》。影片北美周末票房预计约2400万美元，略低于此前预期，但获得了A-级CinemaScore，这一成绩在恐怖片中相对少见。
良好的观众评价、口碑传播以及临近万圣节的档期，可能帮助《泥脸》维持后续走势。作为参照，《痴迷》以1700万美元开画，凭借A-评分在之后三个周末均取得超过2000万美元票房；《另一个妈妈》开画达到4560万美元，但CinemaScore仅为D+，三周累计票房为5150万美元。
这些案例只能用于观察影片的续航可能，并不能证明《泥脸》已经盈利。现阶段更准确的判断是，其开画成绩虽不及大型超级英雄电影，但较低的制作成本让商业风险明显更低。

DualShockers：9.5/10

游戏世界中还隐藏着大量秘密，包括隐藏BOSS、支线故事，甚至是完全可选的区域，让探索体验与战斗系统和角色成长系统一样出色。尽管游戏的运行表现存在一些小问题，但我几乎找不到任何需要对S-GAME的《影之刃零》进行改动的地方。如果它最终入围TGA的年度游戏大奖提名名单，我也不会感到意外。

content.v: Kotaku以“万圣节前还能通关”为思路，整理了13款短篇恐怖或诡异题材游戏。名单中的作品流程约为20分钟至3小时，重点是让玩家在较短时间内获得一次完整体验，并未设置评选名次。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261026/1792972718_164240_jpg_r.jpg
名单首先介绍了2025年的《黏土之子》。玩家需要在昏暗房间内研究一尊古怪的小雕像，并参照笔记解开其中的秘密。《偏执狂》则在杀手、走私者和观鸟者三种视角间切换，通过受诅录像带、异常生物及阴谋营造不安感。
《解剖》围绕黑暗空屋、白噪声和旧录音展开，逐渐扭曲玩家对空间的理解。其余入选作品还包括界面叙事合集《未诉之事》、1995年的生存恐怖游戏《钟楼》、照片风格冒险游戏《床下的黑暗》以及水下宗教恐怖作品《水子宫世界》。
名单还收录了让玩家模拟接线员处理异常求助的《家庭安全热线》，以及《迷狂》《养马大师》和《inside》。最后一款《一年一度的鬼城南瓜节》整体氛围更轻松，最多支持20人共同雕刻南瓜，不过服务器仅在季节活动期间开放。
外媒详细报道：
直到这周，我才终于闻到一股凉爽的秋叶香气，于是顺手在回家的路上买了个南瓜。想到离万圣节只有一周了，妖魔鬼怪们就要在街巷里游荡讨糖了，真是让人不寒而栗。如果你也感觉节日悄然而至，现在抓紧时间准备一些万圣节的惊喜也为时不晚。
许多玩家会根据游戏发售后的游玩天数、月数甚至年数来衡量其价值。值得庆幸的是，恐怖游戏似乎是个例外。这类游戏奖励玩家在合适的时机退出。虽然《P.T.》这类游戏不太容易找到，但还有许多其他短小精悍的恐怖游戏可以让你毛骨悚然。以下推荐十三款时长从二十分钟到三小时不等的惊悚小游戏，让你在万圣节的妖魔鬼怪来袭之前，赶紧体验一番。
《泥土之子（The Children of Clay）》（2025）
巴拉兹·罗尼亚伊的《泥土之子》在短短几分钟内所展现的内容，足以令那些耗时数日的游戏黯然失色。它与M·R·詹姆斯的《好奇者的警告》有异曲同工之妙，玩家将在昏暗的客厅里仔细研究一个神秘的小雕像。这种亲密而又不明智的做法，迫使玩家翻阅笔记来解读这件遗物的秘密，而阴影则在暗处悄然逼近。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261026/1792974314_406320_jpg_r.jpg
《解剖（Anatomy）》（2016）
说到磁带和压抑的氛围，Kitty Horrorshow 的开创性作品《解剖》（Anatomy）堪称电子游戏领域中那种恐惧的极致体现。你身处一栋空荡荡、昏暗阴森的房子里，只有白噪音和老旧的录音陪伴着你。正当你开始理解自己与这空间的关系时，它会在你周围扭曲变形，彻底颠覆你的认知。游戏本身仿佛也在挣脱束缚，挑战你能否坚持到最后，看看地下室里究竟隐藏着什么。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261026/1792974312_392096_jpg_r.jpg
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261026/1792974314_698052_jpg_r.jpg
《偏执狂(Paratopia)》（2018）
杰西卡·哈维的《Paratopia》是一款类似《妖夜慌踪》的清醒梦魇。游戏在三个角色之间切换：一名职业杀手、一名走私犯和一名观鸟者。你将实时体验他们的生活，从闲聊到公路驰骋，你会发现周围的一切开始逐渐展开。令人毛骨悚然的生物、被诅咒的录像带以及一个你可能只是略窥门径的阴谋都将浮出水面。如果你从未接触过《Paratopia》，或者渴望体验更多，那么重制/混音版《Overdub》已于上个月发布。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261026/1792974312_996909_png_r.webp
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261026/1792974312_717087_jpg_r.jpg
《未诉之事（Stories Untold）》(2020)

早在《寂静岭：小镇沦陷》问世之前，开发商No Code（现已更名为Screen Burn）就凭借一系列与界面紧密相连的恐怖故事，让玩家不寒而栗。当你启动电脑，开始玩复古文字冒险游戏《弃屋》（The House Abandon）时，很快就会发现游戏中的事件正步步逼近你的电脑房间。2020年，这款令人印象深刻的开场恐怖游戏被收录到《未诉之事》（Stories Untold ）中，这是一部包含众多恐怖故事的合集，玩家需要面对各种各样的屏幕才能体验到这些故事。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261026/1792974313_541704.jpg

随着生存恐怖游戏这一新兴类型的逐渐成型，神秘的Human Entertainment在超级任天堂主机上涉足了一片未知领域。受达里奥·阿基多《惊魂记》和《深夜止步》等意大利恐怖片的启发，《钟楼》讲述了四个孤儿受邀前往巴罗斯庄园寻找新家的故事。然而，令他们震惊的是，这竟是一个可怕的陷阱。玩家需要揭开这座宅邸的秘密，拯救朋友，并躲避“剪刀人”的追杀，才能在夜幕降临后生存下来。这款经典游戏拥有多种玩法，并衍生出不少疯狂的续作。但对于那些更喜欢使用现代硬件的玩家来说，WayForward在2024年推出了忠实还原的重制版。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261026/1792974313_846038_jpg_r.jpg
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261026/1792974313_706330_jpg_r.jpg
《床下的黑暗（Darkness Under My Bed）》(2021)
这款游戏画面诡异，让人不寒而栗。它是一款冒险游戏，画面由大量照片构成，展现了一个巨大的洞穴，里面堆满了玩偶、立体模型和灰尘。玩家将操控无人机穿梭于一个男孩建造的迷宫，这个迷宫是为了困住藏在他床垫下的怪物。随着迷宫不断延伸，污渍也变得越来越不祥，你会隐隐觉得，这个孩子或许真的成功困住了什么东西。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261026/1792974314_425839_jpg_r.jpg
《水子宫世界（Water Womb World）》（2020）
多年来，Yames发布了不少短小精悍、免费且令人毛骨悚然的恐怖游戏，而这款水下信仰考验游戏无疑是入门佳作。你扮演一位虔诚的科学家，希望通过在海底搜寻天使来融合自己的信仰与实践。在深海沟的黑暗中，你将直面神性，并赌一把你愿意让多少神性渗入你的血肉。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261026/1792974314_456711_jpg_r.jpg
《家庭安全热线（Home Safety Hotline）》（2024）
现在应该很清楚了，有很多恐怖游戏都是以查看电脑屏幕上的电脑为主题的。虽然《家庭安全热线》让你和那些身处险境的人保持了一定的距离，但这并不意味着你不会感到一丝丝诡异。你在一家呼叫中心工作，专门处理人们遇到的……异常情况。你需要查阅你的神秘词汇和诡异事件索引，尽力帮助电话那头的人。这就像是世界末日版的《请出示文件》，只不过主角阿特·贝尔可能会接到类似的求助电话。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261026/1792974314_948009_jpg_r.jpg
《Ecstatica》（1994）
虽然生存恐怖游戏的最终发展方向是由《生化危机》奠定的，但历史上也曾出现过一种更接近初代《鬼屋魔影》的局面。 《Ecstatica》是一款略显滑稽却又魅力十足的游戏，讲述的是一个中世纪村庄被狼人、巨魔以及你那硕大的椭圆形屁股围困的故事。在这款短小精悍却又充满挑战的复古游戏中，你需要奋力反击、解谜并努力生存下去。而且，《Ecstatica》及其续作的现代移植版将于明日正式发售。
《马术大师》（Horse Master）(2013)
作为一款经典的Twine游戏，《马术大师》让你扮演一位雄心勃勃的马术大师。游戏伊始，你或许会以为自己只是在繁育、饲养、骑乘和驯服马匹。但随着游戏的深入，你与马贩子的对话将逐渐展开，你对马匹的认知，以及最终谁将主宰一切的思考，都将逐渐揭开面纱。
《Inside》（2016）
在我们无比耐心地等待Playdead工作室十年来的最终成果之际，何不重温一下你为何会在发售日当天就入手这款游戏呢?你将扮演一个身处黑暗世界的男孩。在阴影中穿行，你必须找到出路，避开敌对的当地居民、苍白的生物以及令人作呕的精神控制实验。这款游戏被无数次模仿，却从未被超越。它曾令无数玩家为之着迷，至今仍有许多人试图揭开其错综复杂的谜团。
《一年一度的鬼城南瓜节（The Annual Ghost Town Pumpkin Festival）》（2020）
好吧，也许并非所有这些游戏都会让你熬夜。由《A Short Hike》的 Adam Robinson-Yu制作的《年度鬼城南瓜节》是一款多人南瓜雕刻模拟器。最多可容纳20人，你可以重现去南瓜地采摘南瓜、乘坐闹鬼的干草车、探索秋日秘密，当然还有雕刻属于你自己的南瓜灯。不过，有个限制！就像游戏中的活动一样，这款游戏每年只开放一次，因为服务器会随着季节的结束而关闭。万圣节快乐！

总评：
在合适的情况下，《影之刃零》的战斗表现堪称惊艳。本作以武侠为灵感的动作设计，出色地还原了其所借鉴的高速动作作品中那种行云流水、攻防交替的战斗节奏。能够轻松砍倒数十名几乎毫无还手之力的敌人，这本身并非致命缺陷，但却会让战斗变得乏味。而且，玩家明明知道战斗本可以有多么刺激，这反而让这一问题显得更加突出。
正是这一设计上的失误限制了《影之刃零》的表现。不过，它依然是一款出色的游戏，任何动作游戏爱好者都值得一试。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/26/small_202610260824153219.jpg

以武侠为灵感的战斗系统，成功还原了这一类型作品中狂野奔放、行云流水的动作体验。 将攻击与防御融为一体，打造出独特的战斗机制。 武器种类丰富，各具特色。 美术风格独树一帜，游戏中的各个场景也各有看点，探索过程令人享受。

故事脉络晦涩难懂，难以让玩家产生兴趣。 普通敌人过于弱小，战斗容易变得乏味。

《影之刃零》是一款令人惊叹的动作角色扮演游戏，其表现足以与史上最优秀的游戏一较高下。本作拥有出色的战斗系统、美丽的游戏世界，以及充满自信与原创性的故事，而这一切都被包裹在一款本质上经过精巧设计的类银河战士恶魔城游戏之中。这是一款与众不同的杰作。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/26/small_202610260817367299.png
CGMagazine：95/100
平台：PC
第一次看到《影之刃零》时，我觉得这款游戏根本不可能实现。但亲自体验之后，我脑海中唯一的想法就是：毫无疑问，这是有史以来最优秀的动作游戏之一。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/26/small_202610260817438754.png
GamesRadar+：90/100
平台：PC
丰富且经过精心设计的游戏世界中，隐藏着大量秘密BOSS和强力武器，而本作的战斗系统更是轻而易举地胜过了大多数同类作品。无论是战斗本身的爽快感，还是战斗过程的流畅程度，都令人称赞。《影之刃零》由此证明了自己是今年最出色的动作冒险游戏之一。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/26/small_202610260817486099.png
Push Square：90/100
平台：PS5
S-GAME为《影之刃零》筹备了近十年，而最终的成果也让这份心血结出了硕果，为PS5带来了一款顶尖的动作游戏。本作以紧张刺激、节奏飞快的战斗系统为最大亮点，并以丰富多样的战斗内容作为支撑，同时还设计了实力强劲、足以考验玩家的敌人。此外，趣味十足的探索、美轮美奂的画面以及独特的风格，也进一步提升了游戏的整体表现。《影之刃零》达到了该类型游戏顶尖作品的水准，完全有资格跻身最优秀游戏的行列。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/10/26/small_202610260817566735.png

《影之刃零》成功实现了自己的目标，打造出了流畅出色、极具电影感的功夫风格战斗体验。然而，游戏在平衡性和整体品质方面存在的问题，最终还是削弱了它的光彩。

items.title: 《影之刃零》评测：功夫朋克外壳下，是一个真正的武侠江湖

content.v: 在当今国产单机游戏迎来爆发与转型的时代，灵游坊历经数年打磨的《影之刃零》选择了一条极具野心且特立独行的道路，它在用一种属于自己的逻辑来定义“武侠游戏”应该怎么做。
过去这些年，高难度ARPG游戏几乎被等同于“类魂”。体力条、翻滚无敌帧、等待破绽、死后跑图——这套设计被反复借用，以至于玩家在看到任何一款略微硬核的游戏时，都会说出“又是类魂”。《影之刃零》则从这套设计逻辑里抽身而出，并巧妙地将其与独树一帜的“功夫朋克”暗黑武侠美学融合在一起。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1026/20261026001547-8035-27444.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
战斗

《影之刃零》的核心是战斗，而战斗的核心资源是“杀气”。敌我双方各有一条杀气槽，它既是架势条，也是攻防转换的枢纽，普通攻击和闪避也不会消耗任何杀气。具体到操作层面：按住L1基本能防御住大多数攻击，但按住防御会持续消耗己方杀气，也会在受到攻击时减少杀气，杀气耗尽即被破防；精准防御则不消耗杀气，反而能大幅削减敌人的杀气。更换另一把武器可以瞬间回满杀气，但换武器有冷却时间，不能无脑轮换。当敌人放出蓝光或红光技能时，需要精确按下L1或R1来应对，而在敌人进攻间隙主动出手，也是削减其杀气的手段。一旦敌人杀气被清空，便会暂时进入破防状态，此时就是我们的输出窗口。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1026/20261026001600-7093-26243.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
与之配套的是极高的战斗上限。主角的闪避动作“鬼步”在成功化解敌方闪烁红光的特殊攻击后，能够夺回战斗主动权，形成一套从防守瞬间切入进攻的节奏转换。它的逻辑更接近格斗游戏的思路，你需要在极短的窗口里做出判断，直接决定接下来是压制对方还是被对方反打。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1026/20261026001608-1538-91857.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
武器系统进一步放大了这种进攻性。游戏中多达30种主武器和25种副武器，每个种类的武器拥有完全独立的动作模组，每把武器也都配备了两种酷炫的处决动作，特定敌人甚至还有专属的处决动画，很多动作都让我感叹“我以前在武侠电影里见过这招”，这种一招一式从内到外散发出的武侠味都非常地道。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1026/20261026001553-6670-84200.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70

游戏并不鼓励一套Build从头打到尾。面对重型盾牌敌人时，重型武器的破盾效率明显更高；人偶类敌人无法被吸血和流血，依赖异常状态的打法会事倍功半；而擅长火焰、雷电或毒属性的敌人，则需要你佩戴对应的减伤饰品来减少伤害。很多BOSS在击败后会掉落他们的武器，游戏用极低的成本鼓励你尝试这些“新玩具”——升级过的武器素材和资源可以基本免费或仅以很小代价回退，用于强化刚刚到手的新武器。这种设计，让这些各具特色的武器不至于埋没在背包之中。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1026/20261026001548-7499-88928.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70

难度层面，《影之刃零》也摆出了相当友好的姿态。三种难度在游玩过程中可以随时切换，最高难度除了敌人伤害更高之外，更多是要求你熟悉敌人的出招方式。通关后解锁的“六十六天”难度则是在最高难度基础上加入了66条命的限制，属于给硬核玩家准备的额外挑战。当加点加出“处决回血”，再配合带有吸血功能的武器和影之武装之后，除了BOSS战之外其实就很少会用到药瓶了；而药瓶的回复效果和使用次数本身还可以升级。这套成长曲线应该能让新手玩家顺利走到结局。
当然，游戏的战斗系统也并非十全十美。一个小瑕疵在于，当玩家同时面对超过三个小怪时，很容易陷入被多重持续攻击逼迫着不断招架、很难抽出手来进攻的窘境；特别是某些远程杂兵的攻击频率过高，我们防守时还伴随着明显的击退效果，容易打乱战斗节奏，好在游戏中绝大多数战斗场景都将杂兵数量控制在了三人以内。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1026/20261026001607-7866-99076.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70

纵观整部作品，《影之刃零》中数十场大大小小的BOSS战无疑是最让人回味无穷的精髓，称得上是近年来BOSS战设计最出色的动作游戏之一。无论是将非遗文化与机关术结合的舞狮战、剑气纵横的七星剑阵，还是由动作巨星甄子丹饰演的神秘人对决，还有众多无法在这篇评测里透露的BOSS战，他们的战斗设计与演出效果都给我留下了难以磨灭的震撼印象。配合本作极低的试错成本——Boss门前就是复活点，没有死亡惩罚，多阶段Boss战中战败后直接从当前阶段重开——它更像是在邀请玩家把“打不过”理解为“还没找到对的打法”，而不是“练度不够，回去刷”。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1026/20261026001611-3149-96662.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
探索

游戏的体量极其庞大，我大约耗时26小时打出了普通结局，此时全图的整体收集率仅为70%，甚至还有一整张庞大的地图完全没有涉足。如果想要打出真结局，则需要深入探索并收集更多的隐藏物品、完成特定的支线与隐藏剧情，同时击败若干隐藏BOSS。非常人性化的是，游戏支持一周目内完成全收集与真结局，即便是打完普通结局后，也可以随时返回到最终战前的存档继续补完地图探索。而在地图结构设计上，本作表现得相当成熟和平衡，几乎不会出现让人头疼的迷路现象。大多数岔路都采用了简洁的“二选一”逻辑，且其中一条分支通常很快就会走到尽头，极大方便了玩家返回岔路口探索正确的主线。此外，地图中还散落着许多类似“银河恶魔城”式的锁闭区域，需要玩家在中后期取得特定的“影之武装”后再折返回来开启，这种前后呼应的探索反馈感拉得非常满。
但它在内容密度上做出了一个明确的选择：敌人被击败后不会重生。这个设计选择避免了跑路时的重复战斗，让探索的节奏更连贯。尽管敌人不会重生，但资源供给并没有因为不刷怪而变得拮据。战斗和探索给的资源足够用，后期足以将常用的主武器、影之武装、饰品和药瓶都升到满级。主副武器还可以通过“铸魂”来升级隐藏属性，而铸魂所需的材料通常放在重要宝箱或剧情奖励里。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1026/20261026001605-8207-75452.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
叙事
《影之刃零》在叙事上做了一个聪明的分割。主线采用清晰、传统的武侠叙事，玩家可以顺畅地理解主角“魂”与左殇的故事脉络，没有太多谜语人的地方；碎片化叙事被留给支线角色和非关键Boss。就我的阅读感受而言，本作的剧情像是在看一本古龙小说——节奏利落，对白有江湖气，有一些故弄玄虚的内容，但该讲清楚的地方都讲清楚了。
支线故事则主要隐藏在“记忆之花”等收集品里，需要你主动收集和阅读，才能拼出那些主线之外的人与事。对于一个以高速动作体验为优先级的游戏来说，这个选择是务实的：它不要求玩家在刀光剑影之间停下来拼凑录音和残破日记，但也保留了愿意深挖的人能挖到东西的余地。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1026/20261026001549-2671-80058.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
视听

薄彩生操刀的配乐是《影之刃零》的另一大出彩之处。古风与电子乐结合，琵琶与失真吉他共存，传统丝竹与戏曲唱腔穿插其间，又在需要的时候毫无违和地切进摇滚乐和电子乐。比如舞狮Boss战第一阶段的配乐来自实地录制的传统舞狮现场，第二阶段立刻切进冲击力极强的电子乐，连同场面一起转入现代朋克的气质。几个视觉风格强烈的支线关卡里，低音与不和谐噪音交织堆叠，制造出一种“诡谲的中式恐怖氛围”。很多场BOSS战的配乐尤其让人印象深刻：有些旋律激昂，能把战斗推向高潮；有些甚至走的是舒缓路线，但和场景氛围搭得恰到好处，反而比一味轰鸣更让人记得住。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1026/20261026001602-3353-87466.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70

画面层面，本作对中式美学的呈现相当扎实。建筑物充满了中式美学的特色，飞檐、斗拱、雕梁、灯笼的暖光与青灰的石阶形成冷暖对照，氛围营造得非常到位。一些凄凉和诡异的场景——荒废的村落、雾气弥漫的树林、烛火摇曳的地下密室——都做出了应有的氛围，不是那种用堆料到窒息的密度来炫耀机能的画面，但在美术方向的一致性上，它知道自己要的是什么。本次评测游玩的是PC版，测试平台为AMD锐龙7 9850X3D处理器、iGame GeForce RTX 5080 Vulcan OC 16GB显卡、iGame X870E VULCAN OC V14火神主板、32GB DDR5 6000MHz内存，选择4K分辨率和全部最高画质选项，开启路径追踪和DLSS 4.5 动态多帧生成，在120Hz刷新率的电视上游戏全程稳定在120帧左右。唯一一次明显的性能波动出现在某场雨中BOSS战，出现了优化问题导致卡顿，除此之外的表现都相当扎实，视觉体验称得上赏心悦目。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1026/20261026001551-4427-92756.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
除此之外，还有一些不影响核心体验但确实存在的小瑕疵：过场动画和游戏画面的衔接不够顺畅；某张地图里开船靠岸的操作感和镜头过渡都显得拖沓了一些；还有一些看起来原本像是追逐战的关卡是以过场动画的形式呈现，不免有些遗憾。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/1026/20261026001610-3546-32426.jpg?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
A9VG体验总结
在我放下手柄、回头审视《影之刃零》的旅程时，最强烈的感受是“这是一个呈现了梦想中武侠世界的那种江湖氛围的作品”。从剧情到武器到动作招式，从甄子丹的出场到舞狮的锣鼓，它遵从的是一种记忆深处共通的武侠江湖感觉。游戏中很多细节堆在一起，构筑的是一个你真的愿意走进去、并且走过之后还想再走一遍的世界。
《影之刃零》用庞大而精致的箱庭架构、极具东方意韵的视听演出以及充满张力的高速战斗，成功搭建出了一个令人沉醉的暗黑江湖。它不仅呈现了属于玩家心中对于武侠的幻想，更用扎实的体量与文化表达，为武侠游戏树立了一座新标杆。如果你是一位向往刀光剑影的“江湖客”，那么这场历经六十六天的宿命绝唱，绝对是一次不可错过的终极体验。

content.v: 《使命召唤：现代 战争 4》玩家发起请愿，要求动视和IW为《使命召唤：现代战争4》DMZ加入纯PvE选项。DMZ目前采用PvPvE撤离玩法，是否应让玩家避开真人对抗、专注 合作 任务和AI战斗，已在社群中引发分歧。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261026/1792972315_327763_jpg_r.jpg
在现有设计下，玩家探索Hajin、执行任务、搜集内容并对抗AI敌人时，几乎不可避免地会遇到其他真人玩家。偏爱PvP的玩家认可这种安排，另一部分玩家则希望获得以合作、任务和AI战斗为主的内容。
相关讨论随后从社交媒体延伸至Change.org。一名玩家建立请愿页面，主张纯PvE模式能够满足偏好叙事或合作体验的玩家，也可以为任务形式的剧情扩展提供空间。
《逃离塔科夫》《失落星船：马拉松》《深入红河》《灰区战争》和正在测试PvE内容的《ARC Raiders》也被用于说明撤离玩法并非只能依靠玩家对抗。不过，目前能够确认的仍只有玩家请愿和社群争论，动视与Infinity Ward尚未作出回应，也没有信息表明纯PvE模式已经进入开发。
外媒详细报道：
如果你过去几天完全没有关注《使命召唤》全新撤离射击模式的相关消息，那就让我来告诉你发生了什么。目前，社交媒体上正上演一场激烈争论：偏爱PvP的玩家与偏爱PvE的玩家针锋相对，而争议的核心在于，《现代战争4》缺少面向PvE玩家的核心内容。
简单来说，DMZ本质上是一种PvPvE模式。PvP玩家对此非常满意，PvE玩家却觉得自己受到了冷落。这促使一些人采取行动。除了在社交媒体上表达不满，并@动视的社区工作人员外，一名不满的玩家甚至发起了一项请愿，要求为DMZ加入PvE内容。
那么，DMZ应该加入PvE吗?
DMZ本质上是一个以PvPvE为核心的模式，这意味着你在探索哈金时，几乎肯定会遇到其他玩家。问题是，并非所有人都想要这样的体验。那些只想安安稳稳地探索世界、完成任务、占领目标并刷AI敌人的玩家认为，动视和Infinity Ward亏待了他们。
这是近年来第一款完全没有特别行动或僵尸模式等PvE内容的《使命召唤》游戏，因此，《使命召唤》玩家群体中的这部分人觉得自己遭到了冷落。
诚然，这是一个棘手的问题。DMZ是一种撤离模式，有人可能会说，这类模式需要玩家之间的战斗才能蓬勃发展，但这种说法并不完全正确。目前市面上提供PvE模式或内容的撤离类游戏，比完全不提供PvE的还要多。
其中包括《逃离塔科夫》《马拉松》《入侵：红河》和《灰区战争》——后者严格来说只是接近撤离类游戏。正如我们所知，Embark Studios也正在测试为《ARC Raiders》加入PvE内容。这还只是我随口就能想到的几款，其中一些甚至根本不是多人游戏。
许多人想体验撤离玩法的循环，却不想面对那些拼尽全力取胜的高手、躲在暗处偷袭的玩家、蹲守撤离点的人、作弊者，以及通常伴随PvP导向和高竞争性平台而来的种种恶意行为。但在DMZ中，这种体验并不存在：你要么为生存而战，要么干脆别玩。
另一方面，一些PvP玩家把那些想要纯PvE体验的玩家称为“软弱”，却没有意识到，如果PvE玩家离开PvPvE大厅，转而进入专门的PvE模式，那么留在这些大厅里的，就只剩下真正想与其他玩家交战的人。
有人在Change.org上发起请愿，要求动视和Infinity Ward推出PvE模式。请愿发起者写道：“ 动视，引入PvE选项可以为《现代战争4》注入新的活力。它可以成为一座桥梁，吸引那些更喜欢叙事导向或合作玩法的玩家，并有望提升销量、玩家参与度以及游戏社区的整体满意度。加入PvE也能为拓展《现代战争4》的叙事创造新的机会，通过围绕这一独特区域精心设计的任务，带来全新的内容和故事线。”
我认为，IW最终会加入一些以PvE为主的内容。在众多同类游戏都提供PvE的情况下，它目前却只有PvPvE模式，这似乎有些说不过去，但这就是现状。以上看法来自一个两种玩法都喜欢的人——至少有时候如此。

content.v: 《复仇者联盟5：毁灭日》近期被曝进行过试映，试映版本体片长约2小时50分钟，早期观众的整体反应较为积极。不过，相关信息尚未得到漫威、制片方或试映组织方确认。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261026/1792971832_339798_jpg_r.jpg
业内爆料人Daniel Richtman透露，一名观众认为影片“好于预期”。角色方面，消息称X战警成员镭射眼在试映中相当抢眼，成为突出角色之一。小罗伯特·唐尼饰演的毁灭博士同样获得肯定，有观众将其列入漫威电影宇宙表现最佳的反派之列。
影片还涉及复仇者联盟成员关系变化、神奇四侠加入、X战警与瓦坎达等多条线索，据称至少包含一个重要的片尾场景。目前流出的片长、角色戏份及评价均属非官方爆料，成片内容和时长仍可能调整。
外媒详细报道：

知名业内人士丹尼尔·里奇曼（Daniel Richtman）在网上更广为人知的名字是丹尼尔·RPK（Daniel RPK）。他透露了近期《复仇者联盟5：毁灭日》试映的一些零星消息，称首批观众走出影院时都对影片印象极为深刻。其中一人表示，这部片长两小时五十分钟的电影——还不包括为提前做好准备而补看或重温某些剧集和电影所需的几十个小时——“比预想中好太多了”。如果你是X战警的粉丝，希望看到自己最喜欢的变种人占据核心位置，而你最喜欢的变种人恰好又是镭射眼，那么这次可有眼福了：据说他抢尽了风头。
这些早期试映传出的其他零星消息还包括：毁灭博士被誉为漫威电影发展至今最出色的反派之一，影片也至少会有一个重要的片尾彩蛋。考虑到托尼·斯塔克死后，一些粉丝对小罗伯特·唐尼回归这一系列持有强烈的怀疑态度，他饰演毁灭博士的表现如此出色，无疑是件好事。再结合我们已经知道的其他一些细节，比如彩虹桥将会回归，成为片中星际英雄们往来的通道，《复仇者联盟5：毁灭日》看起来或许真的能够不负期待。

正如最近的电视宣传片所强调的那样，整个复仇者联盟都处在动荡和变化之中。山姆·威尔逊明明就在场，蚁人却仍把史蒂夫·罗杰斯称为“美队”;史蒂夫和雷神的生活中也都有了孩子。对这支团队来说，一切都已经不同了，尤其是神奇四侠即将登场，这会进一步改变众人之间的关系。此外，曾经担任美国队长、如今以美国密探之名打击犯罪的约翰·沃克也将加入其中。随着史蒂夫回归，而山姆仍在努力争取人们对他美国队长身份的认可，整个局面显得格外混乱。
不过，除了这一切，影片还要处理更多内容，包括X战警、瓦坎达正在发生的事情，以及托比·马奎尔版蜘蛛侠将会登场。如今听说这部电影不仅成功兼顾了所有错综复杂且不断变化的部分，还构建出一个必定能给广大观众留下深刻印象的故事，着实令人振奋。这些观众甚至可能包括那些对漫威近期的营销策略不太满意、不完全认同该系列当前发展方向的粉丝，以及那些认为近年来粉丝服务和形式大于内容已经主导这一IP的人。

content.v: 前bioware设计师约翰·温斯基表示，EA收购bioware并非工作室走向衰落的起点，而是帮助其化解了迫近的破产危机。他将当时的财务压力主要归因于开发周期超过七年的《 龙腾世纪：起源 》。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261026/1792963706_994033_jpg_r.jpg
温斯基曾在bioware任职16年，参与过《博德之门》至《质量效应3》在内的10个项目。按照他的回忆，如果没有大型发行商介入，bioware可能在2000年代中期便已破产。
《龙腾世纪：起源》开发期间，约450人的团队持续产生工资及运营成本，工作室却长期没有相应的新作发售收入。温斯基认为，如果计入项目七年多开发周期内的全部累计成本，该作在bioware保持独立的情况下无法收回全部投入。
联合创始人雷·穆齐卡和格雷格·泽舒克当时一直设法维持公司运转，并未让普通开发人员直接接触财务困境。因此，团队成员并不了解资金短缺的严重程度。
bioware随后先进入VG Holding。这家公司由高管约翰·里奇蒂耶洛参与推动，音乐人博诺也进行了投资。里奇蒂耶洛出任EA首席执行官后，bioware又归入EA；交易发生时，《龙腾世纪：起源》已经开发约五年。
温斯基称，EA承担并核销了工作室在此前五年积累的债务。由此核算《龙腾世纪：起源》的账面表现时，只计入了其2009年发售前最后两年的费用，最终呈现盈利。

content.v: Anthropic与OpenAI正在强化知识产权相关限制。AI仍可用于游戏及其他软件开发，但直接复制受保护的软件或游戏内容，更可能触发输出拦截、警告或账号措施。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261026/1792963466_130137_jpg_r.jpg
AI编程工具的使用范围正在扩大。OpenAI数据显示，截至2026年6月，Codex每周用户已超过500万，应用场景包括应用程序、自动化项目和游戏开发。Anthropic披露，计算机和数学相关任务约占Claude.ai对话的35%，使用AI编程代理的GitHub项目占比也增长逾一倍。不过，两家公司均未公布足以精确统计所谓“AI粗制内容”游戏或应用数量的数据。
Anthropic于9月22日推出Claude Opus 5.5，并将复杂任务和编程列为主要用途。该公司展示的案例显示，这一模型曾在不到一天内迁移一个包含68万行代码的代码库。与此同时，Claude的内容过滤系统会通过提示信息中止部分输出，相关限制也用于阻止受保护材料被重新生成。
按照Anthropic的规则，用户不得利用其服务侵犯他人知识产权。故意索取受版权保护内容可能收到警告，重复违规者还可能被限制或终止账号，但可以提出申诉。2026年上半年，Anthropic共收到约39.8万次申诉，其中约4.2万次推翻了原决定。
这些规则并不意味着全面禁止逆向工程。Anthropic于10月6日扩展Cyber Verification Program，符合资格的信息安全专业人员可获得Claude更强的网络能力，并适用较宽松的拦截分类器。该公司表示，相关技术具有双重用途，因此需要设置相应限制。
OpenAI则于10月21日发布新版使用政策，新规将于11月20日生效。政策禁止利用其服务侵犯知识产权，也禁止通过未经授权的访问、逆向工程或绕过防护，提取受保护的模型内部推理。该规定并非禁止所有针对第三方软件的逆向工程，但OpenAI条款另行限制对其自身服务、模型、算法和系统进行逆向工程，法律不得限制的情形除外。违规账号可能被停用，用户也可以申诉。

content.v: 开发者maximedgoulet制作了开源模组FoveatedDLSS5，将VR设备常用的注视区渲染思路带到普通显示器。在RTX 4090运行《 巫师3：狂猎 》的8K超宽屏测试中，游戏帧率由约49 FPS升至80 FPS以上，增幅约63%。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261026/1792962311_470975_jpg_r.jpg
VR设备通常借助眼动追踪，把更多渲染资源用于玩家正在注视的区域，并降低外围画面的细节。FoveatedDLSS5默认不追踪视线，而是固定保留屏幕中央区域的完整质量，向画面边缘逐渐降低处理分辨率，因此主要面向超宽屏环境。
该模组是RenoDX DLSS 5 for ReShade的扩展，不会改变游戏选择的输出分辨率。它会在图像送入神经网络前压缩计算网格，处理完成后再恢复至显示器原始分辨率，让DLSS 5覆盖完整画面的同时减少需要处理的像素。用户可分别调整中央高质量区域、过渡带宽度和边缘分辨率。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261026/1792962312_104475.jpg
在7680×2160分辨率和默认设置下，处理网格缩小至5540×2132，像素量约为原来的71%。上述测试采用DLSS 5 Neural Rendering双次处理，开发者表示游玩时很难察觉边缘质量下降。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 《谢泼德指挥官》演员詹妮弗·黑尔和马克·米尔哀悼 BioWare：“所有权人可能没有完全理解 BioWare 是什么”
items.summary: You can say that again.

content.v: As reported by IGN , veteran actors Jennifer Hale and Mark Meer, who voiced the female and male Commanders Shepard in Mass Effect, respectively, directly addressed fans of the series in an October 21 Instagram Live . The two reflected on BioWare, and commiserated over its tragic fate. Here are some highlights from each I pulled from the stream:

Both actors' reactions strike me as so characteristic of their respective backgrounds: Hale is one of the voices of videogames (not to diminish Meer's own extensive resume). She jumped to BioWare's place in the industry and its current crisis. Meer, a standby of the Edmonton theater and improv scene, fixated on the closure's effects on this city he clearly loves.
Both are 100% correct about the collective joy and meaning people found in BioWare's work. That's something private equity can't take from us ⁠—at least not with current technology.

As for Hale's optimism regarding the rights and potential future of the franchise, well, I Want To Believe. Not to obnoxiously needle what seemed like an offhand idea, but I don't think Kickstarter's walking through that door. Aside from Double Fine's Broken Age and the utterly baffling case of Star Citizen, many gaming crowdfunding successes⁠—like Pillars of Eternity and Wasteland 2⁠—still required further, traditional investment to go gold. BioWare and/or its IP would be orders of magnitude more expensive.

There's also precedent to look back on: EA has not done anything with Ultima in over 20 years. Many people don't realize this series was foundational to the development of both Japanese and Western-style RPGs, as EA's poor stewardship has allowed it to almost completely fade from our collective memory.

But I think we're all still waiting on a hero, a man on horseback, and the only riders with deep enough pockets to intervene here are billionaires, other companies on the scale of EA, or the state. With other publicly-traded companies, you'd risk replicating what BioWare went through under EA. I would love it if the Canadian government stepped in , nationalized BioWare, what have you, but it feels like a pipe dream.

The only semi-plausible happy ending I can picture looks like what happened to The Onion : A benevolent/eccentric super-rich guy steps in to save the day with little concern for profitability. Does anyone know one who enjoys RPGs ( or immersive sims , for that matter)?

content.v: 模组作者Arhkain重新启动个人项目Retro Forever，尝试为《 魔兽世界 》构建更完整的第一人称游玩体验，并补充与战斗对应的画面和声音反馈。项目目前仍处早期阶段，并非可以直接下载游玩的成品。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261026/1792960751_956367_jpg_r.jpg
Arhkain表示，自己从2004年起便习惯拉近镜头，以角色双眼的角度观察游戏世界。不过，《魔兽世界》原本并非围绕第一人称玩法设计，缺少相应的图形和界面选项。他曾在 经典 硬核服时期利用WeakAuras，根据战斗事件显示画面，后来因时间和生活因素搁置项目。
接触《魔兽世界》Forever测试版后，Arhkain决定恢复开发，但暴雪调整了战斗模组限制，WeakAuras也停止了相关开发。项目随后借助其分支ForeverAuras继续推进，作者已经处理经典版本转换时出现的部分故障。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261026/1792960752_198574_jpg_r.jpg
按照目前的计划，Retro Forever将首先制作法师职业。如果玩家表现出足够兴趣，作者再寻求社区协作，为其他职业补充第一人称图形。项目现有的二维素材直接改编自或受到《毁灭战士》《异教徒》和《上古卷轴2：匕首雨》的启发，主要原因是个人开发者难以承担基于现有三维模型的完整制作。
Arhkain也承认，第一人称视角会削弱空间感，玩家更容易遭到视野外敌人袭击，因此这套玩法未必适合地下城或团队副本。另一方面，近距离视角能够突出游戏内生物的体型和建筑尺度，强化探索时的沉浸感。

content.v: Circana公布的美国市场数据显示，PS5在2026年9月成为唯一实现销量同比增长的主机，销量上升22%，并超过了更新且价格更低的Switch 2。其硬件销售额份额也升至2025年5月以来的最高水平。

content.v: Firaxis已通过“时间的考验”更新调整《文明7》的核心机制，将时代转换改为可选，并重新加入传统的单一文明模式。玩家现在可以使用同一文明完成从开局到结局的完整流程。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261026/1792959841_169313_jpg_r.jpg
《文明7》首发时要求玩家在一局游戏的不同阶段更换文明。这套设计源于Sid Meier长期以来对系列机制的一项不满：文明的独特能力通常只在特定 历史 时期突出，进入其他时期后便缺少特色。创意总监Ed Beach沿用了这一思路，希望玩家在整个历史进程中持续接触不同文化的独特能力。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261026/1792959842_658949_jpg_r.jpg
执行制作人Dennis Shirk承认，这项大幅改变系列公式的设计令玩家产生分歧，尤其没有满足部分老玩家从初代延续至今的期待：让同一文明从开局持续发展到结局。Beach表示，恢复单一文明模式对他个人而言颇具挑战，因为这并不属于最初的设计愿景，但大量玩家明确希望看到同一群体的故事贯穿整局，首发版本未能充分服务这种玩法。
团队在制作更新期间举行了多次公开工作坊，并根据玩家反馈调整内容。Beach认为这一流程效果良好，希望今后继续采用。团队将此次更新视为一次成功调整，不过《文明7》Steam总体评价仍较为复杂，Firaxis目前还在筹备一项新更新，计划与首个扩展内容《地球崛起》同步推出。

content.v: 研究人员开发的Scentronic技术已经能够识别并远程重现五种气味。这项进展也让小岛秀夫近四十年前为《 掠夺者 》提出、最终未能实现的气味构想再受关注。

20世纪80年代，小岛秀夫在科乐美开发这款赛博朋克冒险游戏时，曾希望在软盘表面使用一种受热后散发血腥味的特殊材料，让玩家运行游戏时获得类似案发现场的嗅觉体验。由于该方案可能损害硬件，材料受热后还可能在封闭空间释放化学物质，而且只能生效一次，科乐美管理层最终否决了这一构想。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261026/1792959752_850810_jpg_r.jpg
Scentronic通过“电子鼻”识别气味，再将信息发送至另一台设备，由接收端释放相应的芳香分子，在远处重现相似气味。参与研究的俄亥俄州立大学博士生表示，研究目标是让气味像图像和声音一样实现远程分享。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261026/1792959753_164843_jpg_r.jpg
这套系统现阶段只能识别五种气味，设想中的主要用途包括让网购用户提前感受香水、肥皂和蜡烛的味道，以及向远方亲友分享食物气味。索尼此前也曾登记与游戏及虚拟现实气味释放有关的技术，但目前没有证据表明Scentronic已用于游戏。

content.v: 拥有约2600名演员和声优会员的日本演员联盟提出生成式AI行业准则，要求企业在使用艺人声音训练模型前明确告知本人，并就具体用途、工资及授权报酬展开协商。该提议旨在加强艺人对自身声音和表演的控制，而非全面禁止相关技术。

对于已故演员，联盟提出了更严格的条件。演员生前未作出同意的，不得使用AI模拟其声音；即便已有生前授权，使用方仍需取得在世家属、法定继承人或权利与资产管理机构的许可，相关权利方还应分享商业使用产生的收入。联盟表示，这些要求是为了保护已故艺人的尊严、声誉与遗产。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261026/1792959649_676757_jpg_r.jpg
相关争议案例包括《堡垒之夜》使用AI模拟的詹姆斯·厄尔·琼斯声音说出侮辱性内容，以及《最终幻想起源：天堂的陌生人》中图派克·夏库尔形象的使用。目前，这套方案仍是联盟提出的指导意见，尚不清楚是否已获日本娱乐行业普遍采纳，或会转化为具有强制力的规则。

https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261026/1792959424_694828_jpg_r.jpg
颁奖致辞称，青沼英二是一位会为玩家自身想象留下空间的独特叙事者。法国政府肯定其作品鼓励世界各地的儿童与成年人展开想象、探索新的世界。
青沼英二在接受荣誉时表达了感谢。他表示，自己的主要目标是继续与开发团队合作，让玩家体验规模宏大的冒险。
青沼英二于1988年进入任天堂，后来担任1998年Nintendo 64游戏《塞尔达传说：时之笛》的导演。该作推动系列成功转向三维表现，此后他继续负责多部系列作品的制作，成为构建林克与塞尔达公主冒险世界的关键创作者之一。
此次授勋体现了法国文化机构对电子游戏创作者及互动叙事贡献的正式认可，也反映出《塞尔达传说》系列跨越年龄与地域的文化影响力。

items.title: 独立电影和非续集在去年爆发式增长，而且并不全是友谊片
items.summary: "Indie studios produced 20 of the 21 extra breakout launches in the 2026 cohort," reads one industry analysis.

content.v: You'll never play every game. In fact, most people won't play most games—plenty of games release on Steam to approximately 0 user reviews, and last year, more than half of the 19,000 games that came out had fewer than 10. But that doesn't mean indies and anything else outside of the biggest blockbusters are all sent out to die. So far in 2026, all-original indies have been making waves.

That insight comes courtesy of Sensor Tower (via GamesIndustry.biz ), which recently published an industry analysis report sharing some trends among the year's breakout hits. For reference, a breakout is defined in the study as a game which sold at least 500,000 units in its first 30 days. While ultimately based on estimates as not all publishers release sales numbers, the report is full of interesting tidbits.

The most noteworthy findings in the report are thus: there were 76 breakouts between September 2025 and August 2026, up from the previous year's 55. Indie breakouts shot up from 13 to 33, making up 43% of the pack, and 35 of the breakouts were non-sequels—around 53%. 27 of those were made by indie studios. Nine of the indie breakouts were friendslop hits like Meccha Chameleon and RV There Yet?, while 18 were debuts in other genres, such as Escape From Duckov and Megabonk.

Triple-A blockbusters have not really budged, according to the report. Last year they had 27 breakouts, this year they had 28 (notably, due to the methodology used, some huge games are excluded from this report: no free-to-play games like Marvel Rivals are included, and Call of Duty isn't accounted for.) But this does suggest a strong showing for cheap, often low-spec indies with novel ideas and multiplayer, and if you're longing for something new amidst all the proximity voice chat, you'll be happy to hear that both non-sequels and non-friendslop are making up a sizable portion of the year's hits.

items.summary: The desperate plea to EA has fans sharing their memories of the spacefaring shooter.

others.title: BioWare 关闭后几天，“拯救质量效应”请愿书已收到 50,000 个签名

content.v: Last week, the other shoe dropped for legendary RPG studio BioWare: shortly after EA's acquisition by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund and investment firms Silver Lake and Affinity Partners, the gaming giant shut down BioWare and canceled Mass Effect 5.

Fans have spent the intervening days combing through the detritus of the next game in the series' leaked remains , and some have even signed a change.org petition to save the series. Right now, that #SaveMassEffect petition has hit over 180,000 verified signatures.

Notably it does not call for EA to walk back its decision to shut down BioWare. Instead, it's about keeping the Mass Effect series going: "We are urgently petitioning EA to take decisive action by committing to the continued development of Mass Effect," Joe Smith's plea reads. "Alternatively, EA could consider licensing the Mass Effect intellectual property to another studio that shares the passion and vision to keep it alive and allow it to flourish anew."

Of course, EA is not beholden to the demands of a digital petition—the chances that this will inspire a revolution of the heart throughout the industry's C-suites are not high. One could argue that, if the publisher held the legacy of Mass Effect or, indeed, the computer RPG itself as a priority, it would not have shut down BioWare in the first place. But this petition has proven a lightning rod of enthusiasm for fans of the series, who are sharing their memories of the games along with their signatures.

"You’re gonna have to pry Garrus from my cold dead hands," wrote Savannah. Another from Joe reads, "My wife and I absolutely love the Mass Effect series. We’ve had so many good times together sharing Commander Shepard's story over the years. It really devastated both of us when we heard that BioWare is done and, in turn, Mass Effect 5 wasn’t going to happen." Austin wrote: "The trilogy and even silly Andromeda has made a permanent impact on my life. I’ve been playing for 13 years."

While it's hard to imagine EA doing a 180 on this, it's also hard to imagine Mass Effect staying down for good (even if that might be where we're headed). Maybe Canada's New Democratic Party leader Avi Lewis has the right idea, and BioWare should be publicly funded for the collective good. Either way, the immediate, broader future for games made under the EA banner looks a mite grim .

items.title: Riot 复活了 3 个最大的英雄联盟流行乐队，但只有一个获胜
items.summary: I think I could guess where the budget went, but I'm not complaining.

content.v: https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/WcCZiWMVteuU25phgoBuD8-1920-80.png
Welcome to Critical Hit , where I (or someone else on the PC Gamer team) celebrate and lament all things videogame music, audio design, and the ways our favourite games make our ears tingle.

Despite my experience with League of Legends (the videogame) being incredibly minimal, I've spent years in admiration and awe at League of Legends (the music). Riot has found a real knack for taking its champs and turning them into bona fide popstars, rockstars, and hip-hop stars—bringing in talented and well-established artists across the globe and carving out a space in the mainstream music world with certified bangers fronted by fictional characters.

Some might argue (it's me, I'm some) that Riot Music found the height of its success towards the end of the 2010s with the likes of K-pop girl group K/DA's Pop/Stars and hip-hop group True Damage and their song Giants. The former, in particular, made waves when it released—it topped charts and led to K/DA becoming the first K-pop girl group to be certified platinum. That's not to say it hasn't done anything good since, mind, as 2023 saw Riot convert six of its champs into the boyband Heartsteel, with a distinctly cheeky vibe.

It makes it even more surprising, then, that Riot Music has barely done a thing with any group in the years since. K/DA returned in 2020 with a new look and new EP—which was a banger, by the way—but True Damage and Heartsteel were one-hit wonders, and K/DA has lain dormant for the last six years.

Until now, that is. Over the last couple months, as League of Legends ramps up for its annual Worlds finals, it's been bringing them back from the dead. Heartsteel was the first to make a comeback with the significantly softer Live My Life, and it was… fine. Certainly not my favourite, and the kind of vibe shift I hadn't quite expected from its previous bad-boy persona.

Next came True Damage with Know My Name. It's probably the group that feels closest to its old tone, though I'm sincerely missing Keke Palmer's vocals this time around. The thing that made me more sad with this group's return is its music video—listen, I know Faker is a big deal. But the thing I love with these groups are the champs it puts forward. Having an entire music video dedicated to T1 with barely a glimpse of the champs who serve as a mascot for the song defeats the point of these fictional groups in the first place, at least for me.

But it feels like Riot was saving up all its hype (and perhaps budget) for the return of K/DA. It is still wild to me that the developer has sat on one of the biggest mainstream successes it's seen—I literally only played League of Legends a few months ago, while I've owned the Secretlab K/DA chair for over five years, for example—but the wait has truly been worth it.

It feels like someone at Riot Music really understands what makes K-pop as moreish as it is, because new single Firestarter has been on non-stop repeat for me since it came out. It also brought Fortiche on board for the music video—that's the studio behind both Arcane's animation and the original Pop/Stars MV—for a real full-budget experience.

K/DA is also the only one of the three to get more than one song out of its revival. The group has a four-song EP that just landed, one which grew on me massively over the course of, erm, listening to it on repeat for six hours straight. But it's one that boasts immense production value, as well as the benefit of having K-pop superstars Soyeon and Miyeon from I-dle returning and giving K/DA that much-needed familiar sound.

I think in a battle of the League of Legends bands, K/DA was always going to emerge victorious. It's the one that broke MOBA containment, after all. But with the group sharing the joint stage alongside True Damage during the Worlds finals in New York next month, it's clear Riot has its favourite. And can I blame them? Absolutely not, because K/DA is my favourite too.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/21/masseffect-blogroll-1792622452670.jpg

Additional details about BioWare's canceled Mass Effect game have leaked online, revealing a story that would have taken choices from the Commander Shepard trilogy into account if EA hadn't shut down the studio.

The long-awaited and currently canned follow-up for the sci-fi RPG franchise, which was working under the title Mass Effect: Universe, was built around decisions made in the original games, according to comments shared by former technical director Romain Toutain during a recent livestream (via Kotaku ). As more details about the project leak, there's no telling exactly how thorough this system would have been, but he did his best to give fans an idea.

"All the choices made in the first Mass Effect games were taken into account," Toutain said (translation via Bluesky user @loustica-lucia.bsky.social ). "One of the reasons why it was called 'Mass Effect: Universe' is that you had so many choices. That you could plug your saves together to create parallel universes, to keep it simple. It's not exactly how it worked. You had different timelines, basically."

Mass Effect fans know how crucial the series' overarching story is, especially when it comes to Commander Shepard's first three installments in his/her fight against the Reapers. Outside of the ill-fated Andromeda follow-up that launched in 2017, players were able to carry major choices from each entry over to the next, resulting in a trilogy of games with a highly personalized story.

Relationships, major character deaths, and even the fate of an entire species are just a few of the ways Shepard can be steered to shape the galaxy, and although whether it was all worth it in the end is still up for debate, it seems Mass Effect: Universe would have offered an opportunity to right some wrongs . Toutain said they had plans for those who just prefer to experiment with the story and its many, many branches, too. He likened the freedom to "generate timelines" to Spike Chunsoft's 2016 video game, Zero Time Dilemma .

"You have no f**king idea just how great it was," he continued. Then, responding to a fan asking whether Mass Effect: Universe would have featured systems similar to what was found in Dragon Age: Inquisition and the series' lore-tailoring Keep application, he said, "kinda, yeah."

"It's more like, you can make decisions that might contradict things you've already done or thing you have to do, and so it would create plot 'points' in the timeline. I mean, that was the theory. It worked, in practice. I'll tell you about the tech one day because it was really exciting.

"We got worked up, f**k. Everything in the game. Everything was stateful, and at any time, you could stop the game – I mean you could pause it – and ask a system that solved logical equations, 'Is this valid?' And if it isn't valid, what conditions must be met for it to be valid?"

The ideas Toutain teased sound ambitious and complex, and unfortunately, they will likely never see the light of day. EA announced last week that it had shuttered the long-running RPG developer and canceled what would likely have been called Mass Effect: Universe , with additional plans for the franchise's future in games on hold, too. Fans have already erected a #SaveMassEffect movement in the aftermath, with a petition garnering an unreal 185,000 signatures at the time of this story's publication.

Other highlights from Toutain's stream include the revelation that the Reaper-like hand featured in recently leaked footage was named Billy, as well as the idea that the developers were hoping to craft a story that gave each player a completely unique experience. More information about what Mass Effect 5 would have been have also leaked in the days after BioWare's demise. Those details include a full trailer , as well as gameplay details that promised missions with "Hitman-style freedom." The Prime Video show, meanwhile, is said to still be in the works .

content.v: 据猛犸新闻报道，近日，杭州的田女士花1798万买下钱江世纪城朝龙汇一套460多平的商业大平层，买房时销售承诺7楼会所对业主免费开放。10月19日，她临时想用7楼一间空房开线上会议，物业却要求按每小时300元收费，还威胁要报警把她抓起来。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261026_zy_red_164_2/1120.jpg
田女士介绍，自己是做带货直播的，有一家公司还在装修，所以想要借用7楼会所。而她进去后发现，茶水、水果全另算。更荒诞的是，物业管家先说7楼所有房间已约满，可等田女士硬要上去看，整层楼黑着灯，门上挂着休息中的牌子，预约电话也没人接。物业还改口说2号楼7楼产权在开发商名下，购房时的承诺他们不清楚。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261026_zy_red_164_2/1271.jpg
朝龙汇大厦有1号楼业主群和2号楼业主群，田女士在2号楼业主群里诉说了自己的遭遇后，引起好几位业主的共鸣。有位业主说“卖房子的时候和我说的是7楼是业主会所有泳池、书吧、业主接待茶室、餐厅、儿童游乐场，现在是什么样的我一次没去过”。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/10/20261026_zy_red_164_2/1391.jpg
田女士打算联合业主成立业委会维权。记者也把联系方式留给物业工作人员，希望向开发商转达采访请求，截至发稿没有接到回复。

items.title: 《守望先锋》开发者看了一眼喷气背包猫和堡垒的组合，然后说“哦，这有点吓人”
items.summary: The Apache helicopter meta was certainly something to be feared.

content.v: Almost a year ago now, Team 4 debuted a new kind of Overwatch , and as part of the huge spotlight we learned that the live service FPS would undergo a new cadence with yearly themes comprising several seasons. Five new heroes were also added straight away; Mizuki, Emre, Anran, Domina, and of course Jetpack Cat.

Ahead of being added to the game, Overwatch's community was overjoyed to see Jetpack Cat, an adorable little ginger kitty in a flying mech—what's not to love? But sentiment quickly shifted after she took to the battlefield. Jetpack Cat broke the game with her new Apache helicopter meta which saw her haul Bastion high into the air so he could gun down the entire enemy team while in turret mode, it was truly horrific.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/VthvVKeWrdeNmRndaF347b-1920-80.png

Who could've predicted that the adorable little cat would cause so much havoc? Well Team 4 had an inkling while Jetpack Cat was in the testing phase. "Internally we were like, 'oh, that's a little scary'," Associate Game Director Alec Dawson tells me. "We were play testing [Jetpack Cat and Bastion] a little bit. I think at one point it was also Jetpack Cat, Bastion, and Mercy. The full trio. It's like an even scarier helicopter."

This Jetpack Cat meta became so strong that it dominated OWCS from the get go. I haven't seen a new hero utilised so heavily and quickly in Overwatch's esports scene for a long time, so it brought home just how busted this team-up was.

Jetpack Cat would eventually undergo some reworks , for example, there was a nerf to how quickly she can move while carrying another hero. It helped to even the odds a little, but she can still be very frustrating and a hard hero to deal with. But the choice to leave Jetpack Cat initially un-nerfed was a deliberate decision according to Dawson:

"We want to make sure we put some of those moments in front of players. Allow them to experience a little bit of that crazy stuff before we come in and try to make sure it's in line, right? It's really that fine line of not taking away all the fun, not diluting it, not trying to take away some of the extremes, and seeing how it actually plays out. Because those are the moments that are going to be really exciting for players, those are going to be the moments that they remember in Overwatch, and that's important not to whittle away too early."

items.title: 《黑暗之魂 2》无缝合作是玩 FromSoft 最令人沮丧的游戏的最冷酷方式
items.summary: Don't give up, skeleton(s).

content.v: I have always been one of those pro-Dark Souls 2 revisionists , but man, they really chafe your hams on this one. Iron Keep, Shrine of Amana, Dragon Shrine: Mention these levels to even the most hardened Souls veteran, and they're liable to break into a cold sweat, flashing back to waves of frustrating, overlapping enemies rushing them down to ruin their day. That's not to mention the co-op first DLC zones that mercilessly brutalize the solo player.

FromSoft is a longtime co-op innovator, but its focus has always been limited, diegetic systems meant to supplement solo play, not replace it. Enter legend modder Yui, whose Seamless Co-op series removes the speed bumps of FromSoft co-op, introducing shared story progress and a siloed system of servers and saves to protect your vanilla game progress from anticheat scrutiny.

Even though Dark Souls 2 is rapidly approaching its 13th birthday, it is the most recent game to receive the Seamless Co-op treatment. Its mechanical weirdness and lower popularity compared to other entries may help explain why it's gone last. As a longtime fan of this strange, prickly game, I'm delighted to have found a new favorite way to play it⁠—one with way less trial and error, and way more laughs.

I reunited with PCG contributor Tyler Colp and senior guides writer Sean Martin for this adventure. Together, our ka-tet burrowed its way to the maximum Depth Five difficulty of FromSoft's tied-for-most-frustrating game , Elden Ring Nightreign. By comparison, Dark Souls 2 in co-op has been a cakewalk, and I'm not complaining.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/4acWbY6MhLBwGmH2ZSGopE-1920-80.jpg

Take that Iron Keep area I mentioned: Its first zone puts you through the ringer, a gauntlet of lightning-quick samurai wannabes who swarm you on non-OSHA-compliant catwalks over a lake of lava. Your reward for getting through them? The Smelter Demon , a sphincter-faced lava golem whose most powerful trick is having a trailing, invisible hurtbox behind his every sword swing.

Even though we suffered a few deaths on the way, it never felt frustrating. Part of that is due to your progress not resetting if one player dies. Unless you're fighting a boss or a PvP invader, you just respawn back at the bonfire and can rejoin your fellows. During the two states of exception, you can spectate your still-living squadmates. If everybody dies under any circumstance, it's classic Dark Souls respawn rules.

The Alonne Poseur gauntlet (they're just nerds cosplaying my GOAT, Sir Alonne ) became an easygoing war of attrition, as wars of attrition so often are. It's worthwhile to experience Dark Souls 2 "as intended" at least once, but if you've bounced off in the past or want to revisit it, I can't recommend Seamless co-op enough.
Goth WHAT?

One surprise boon has been a lively PvP scene: You can still get invaded even when undead in Seamless Co-op, and it's apparent that a stay-behind network of Dark Souls 2 PvP sickos has been activated, dusting off their Ice Rapiers and Chaos Blades for one last dance.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/CA8PvhBeNcUGPP5TkgzedT-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/8RtiRKd5dW6CxTMqYTaXmT-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/JH9cFwXot7LhKEsmTtZWqT-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/hGSEzbG4gzqiArvt4eMdpT-1920-80.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/pqhkuYaUrS3W2d9U9xD92U-1920-80.jpg

As in the base game, invasions make for an interesting complication to regular gameplay that I'm always happy to confront, and I really appreciate that Yui's mods make invasions more commonplace than in the vanilla experience. FromSoft typically has PvP be more opt-in, while Seamless Co-op requires you to consciously opt out of the possibility.

As a DS2 PvP old hand myself⁠—I got into a lot of duels on the Threshold Bridge back in 2014⁠—I like to insist we do things honorably and 1v1 invaders. Unless they're really annoying or break etiquette themselves; at that point, it's weapons free. I'm still not sure how I feel about the unfortunately-named invader "Goth Bitch," a naked woman who repeatedly cyberbullied us in the Harvest Valley zone. She was really good at Dark Souls 2 PvP.

There have certainly been technical hitches⁠—mostly weird latency or mismatched details between our instances of the game⁠—but Seamless Co-op mostly just works. Its smoothness and ease of use is especially impressive given that it's a free mod, and Yui was diligently, rapidly squashing bugs in the days immediately after launch. The mod will be there for you whenever you and your friends want to spin up a game, but I'd act soon if you want to take advantage of the reactivated PvP (or get harassed by a nude warrior woman in an evil swamp).
Dark Souls 2: Scholar of the First Sin remains available, as ever, on Steam , while you can grab Seamless Co-op over on the Dark Souls 2 Nexus .

items.title: 《生化奇兵 2》的导演乔丹·托马斯在制作合作恐怖游戏《停电俱乐部》时玩了 7,000 多个小时的《流亡之路》：“我基本上一直都是醒着的”
items.summary: The co-founder of indie studio Question guides us through the games on his PC.

content.v: https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/DEwkbfkEmfdtjT5P9ybme-1920-80.png

Welcome to Disk Cleanup , our regular weekend feature delving into the PCs of PC gaming luminaries. Come back every weekend to read a new interview, digging into the important questions, like "How tidy is your desktop?" and "What game will you never uninstall?"

Jordan Thomas grew up during the shareware era of PC gaming, fed a steady diet of free game demos by his father. "This is embarrassing in a way, but the first one I remember connecting to enough to do drawings at school—and it's so immature—but it's old Commander Keen ," he says. "It was a quick segue from that into Wolfenstein and Quake . So weirdly, Commander Keen was a gateway drug into darker games that would then become my focus for a very long time."

Indeed, Thomas' debut in the games industry was dark in the most literal sense, as he was hired by Ion Storm Austin to work on Thief: Deadly Shadows . There, Thomas built that game's most famous level, The Shalebridge Cradle .

Following Ion Storm's closure, Thomas moved to Irrational, where he led the design of BioShock 's Fort Frolic before moving to 2K Marin and directing BioShock 2 . After working on BioShock Infinite , Thomas founded the indie studio Question, creating games like The Magic Circle , The Blackout Club , and South Park: Snow Day .

Question's most recent game is The Killing Stone , a dark roguelike deckbuilder inspired by Shakespearean drama which has just launched out of early access. "It's set in the 17 th century, and you can play it in 17 th century authentic dialogue—so it's for the real sickos," Thomas says. "It's a series of very strange, deckbuilder-with-a-twist style challenges, where you're trying to un-curse a family's decks, which is pulling sins out of their souls, sins that they inherited from their matriarch."

Thomas took a break from Shakespearean sin-eating to show me around the water-cooled pleasure district of his Steam library. We talked about Hellraiser's hidden influences, immersive sims' hidden comedy potential, and how Path of Exile helped Thomas survive development of The Blackout Club.
What game are you currently playing?
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/QV4bk2tFs9oPvokKiejY9J-1920-80.jpg

I've spectated my friend's playthrough of Hellraiser: Revival , and now I've just started it myself. I'm a dyed-in-the-wool Hellraiser fan from way back, and this is the most lurid possible incarnation of this. But I am really interested in the idea of a decaying relationship in non-Euclidean space, and the people who made this game get that. They're doing it with the chassis of another game that I loved and that fell away. And oddly, I didn't expect that to arrive as a Hellraiser sequel, but that was Condemned .

I prefer melee to shooting for many reasons. I've long since reached saturation point with guns in this country and in my life, so I moved into melee and stayed there. But there wasn't a lot available in first-person [in 2006]. Condemned was right up my alley, and I still would have loved to do a sequel to it or something.

[Monolith]'s programmers of the enemies were early pioneers in finding semi-systemic, often designer-aided, smart things for the enemies to be doing, that helped you believe they had an agenda and they were thinking about things before you entered the room. Again, I wish I'd had the chance to merge Condemned with the immersive sim genre, where the spaces were more plausible and you could approach these spaces from any angle. Condemned was a little more linear, though you still had some freedom in their arenas.

You're on the trail of this Serial Killer X character, and you're ripping locker doors off walls, and it's all about breakable melee weapons. And this is where you'll see it in Hellraiser, exactly that formula for the first half.
Also, my friend Xalavier voices the protagonist, so I just wanted to see him put through hell. Strange Scaffold helped out with [The Killing Stone], and [we're] very grateful to him for that.
What was the previous game you played, and is it still installed?
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/wBU5Licxz9pxjU7PZS4iLW-1920-80.jpg

Just before Hellraiser, I played REPO with my regular crew. Speaking of immersive sim systemic interaction, man, I've never laughed so hard playing a multiplayer game. And even if you account for the friends-as-content success model, which is huge right now, it's still just so well thought out and so expressive that we keep coming back to it.

I tell the story, when I'm trying to sell other imsim nerd types on it, of the moment that a friend was carrying my severed robot head back to the cart to safely resurrect me at some point in the future, and I was controlling a third-person camera around my head, and I'd got just enough battery life to scream at my friends not to turn around and look backwards, because there was a monster behind them that only kills you if you look at it.
I'd never seen a moment like that happen before, where my limited agency death mattered.
Jordan Thomas

I was like, "This game is amazing." I'd never seen a moment like that happen before, where my limited agency death mattered, the camera mattered, the limited communications governed by the battery. All of that came together, plus the enemy design, to create this moment of "Don't look behind you."

The Blackout Club is a long conversation that would eat a lot of our time, but it's definitely true that [in terms of] four friends going into a hostile space and starting out relatively vulnerable and having to improvise—lots of people crack each other up playing The Blackout Club too.

But The Blackout Club also had this live story component, which was so all-consuming. The thing I'm proudest of about that game is that people are playing it when they're not playing it. They were off on the Discord trying to solve mysteries like true crime. Whereas REPO, it's all about the physical … every piece of your body is physicalised.

On Thief 3, I've told this story before, but I got a feature into the game because Paul Weaver, the executive producer at the time, was trying to shut everything down, but he wanted to say yes because I'd built up a lot of good faith, and it was the oil slicks, when they're placed near stairs, would fling guards [down them]. He said, "You can have it if it makes me laugh." We showed it to him and he immediately cracked up.

A little while after Ion Storm Austin shuttered, we were pitching around a comedy immersive sim that's like Burnout with people. It was all about trying to get the most horrific things to happen, and REPO probably would have been very good friends with it.
That's why I'm not particularly devoted to continuing to bang the immersive sim drum anymore … people who took pieces of it are solving things in a way that renews the conversation.
What is the oldest game (by release date) currently installed on your PC?
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/ZB8dYSLx9hQZSBhzKV3bbS-1920-80.jpg
It might be X-COM , the original.

I played it for research for what would become The Bureau: XCOM Declassified . What I chiefly remember—before the trauma began with such a strange, hand-me-down [project]—was the game Exquisite corpse . That's what we call it here. Where you draw a piece of a monster and then fold it down, and somebody else draws the torso of the monster and fold it down, and you unfold it and get this ridiculous thing. That was The Bureau.
